notes.title: Neon Beat is now Neon Exploding Bread!
notes.notes: We've realized to stand out from another game, we needed to rebrand. So we've officially renamed the game to 'Neon Exploding Bread', and leaned more into Jack thinking the beats looked like bread.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes: This update makes the game run self-contained without any runtime files!
